plans.reference_version: Diner Dash PC/Windows downloadable edition as an edition-level benchmark; original replacement is Tiệm Lá Trà, not a parity claim
plans.source_review: The public Shockwave product page identifies a Windows downloadable edition, mouse-directed tasks, seating, orders, delivery, dish clearing, Quick Play/Career, 50 levels and 5 restaurants. It does not establish detailed timing, scoring, queue rules or level layouts. Tiệm Lá Trà is an original compact three-shift service game; meal scoring/table turnover are automatic, without manual billing or cleaning. Nine deterministic model tests and six DOM-double UI/lifecycle tests pass; browser/device/playtest pending. Dossier: docs/games/TEA_SERVICE_RESEARCH_AND_SCOPE.md.
plans.evidence: One official product-description page reviewed; 9 deterministic model and 6 DOM-double UI/lifecycle tests pass; no browser/device acceptance
plans.rules_task: Original loop: seat a fitting group, accept order, FIFO auto-cooking, pick up and deliver to the matched table. Meal scoring and table turnover happen automatically; there is no manual billing, stock or upgrade workflow. The reference page is too high-level to support detailed parity.
plans.controls_task: Tap/click a guest and fitting table, take the order, then use the kitchen and matching-table actions. Meal scoring and table reset are automatic. Pause/restart are covered by DOM doubles; real-browser/device timing remains unmeasured.
plans.progression_items_task: Three original shifts, 15 fixed arrivals, three recipes and targets 320/480/640; persist one active shift and best score. No character progression, upgrades, ads, IAP or borrowed campaign content.
plans.visual_feel_task: Original Tiệm Lá Trà board and authored vector cover, compact touch-sized controls, minimal text and optional synthesized short cues. No third-party character art, fonts or audio; actual contrast/audio/device checks pending.
plans.acceptance: Test complete service cycle, capacity block/retained selection, FIFO cooking/table matching, patience/time loss, shift target/retry, deterministic restore, corrupt/future/quota storage, pause/close/reopen and route cleanup; then repeat on real desktop and mobile browsers and playtest pacing.

plans.reference_version: Mattel UNO W2085 (2010) and official W2085 sheet; exact edition, archetype benchmark only, no parity claim.
plans.source_review: Mattel W2085 product page and official W2085.pdf sheet reviewed. The selected edition specifies 108 cards, 7-card hands, color/number/action matching, Draw Two, Reverse/Skip, Wild Draw Four challenge, last-card callout and 500-point series. Sắc Chuyền deliberately uses four original seasons, 76 cards, 6-card hands, gust draw-two/wild dew, one round and no other branded rules/content. Seventeen model tests and seven DOM-double UI/lifecycle tests pass; full suite 433/433 and static preflight pass; browser/device/playtest pending. Dossier: docs/games/SEASON_SHED_RESEARCH_AND_SCOPE.md.
plans.evidence: Official W2085 product page and sheet reviewed; 17 model and 7 DOM-double UI/lifecycle tests pass; repository suite 433/433; real browser/device/playtest not done
plans.rules_task: Original Sắc Chuyền 1v1 card shed: match by four custom season symbols or 1–8 number; gust draws two/skips, wild dew selects season. No score series, Reverse/Skip/Draw Four/challenge or stacking.
plans.controls_task: Tap/click playable card, draw one and optionally play/pass, choose a season for wild dew; single deterministic AI; no extra setup. Verify mobile scroll, focus, target size and turn safety in real browser.
plans.progression_items_task: Single round; six cards per player. No 500-point series, unlocked modes, stacks, challenge, traditional last-card callout, upgrades, ads or IAP.
plans.visual_feel_task: Original seasonal icons/patterns and card-back/face visuals with no Mattel branding, logo, source art, fonts, sound or music; color-blind support and device QA pending.
plans.acceptance: Deck conservation, match/no-match, every action, draw/play/pass, AI not using human private view, reshuffle, terminal, save restore/corruption/future/quota, restart/close/AI timer cleanup; then real desktop/mobile QA and playtest.
plans.title: Sắc Chuyền
